title: Coefficient restriction on localized derived Hom presheaves
statement: Let J be a Grothendieck topology on an essentially small category C with object universe u+1 and morphism universe u. Let q:B→B′ be a homomorphism of commutative rings in Type(u+1). For A,D in D(Sh(J,Mod B′)), define the natural map from their local derived Hom presheaf to the local derived Hom presheaf between Res_q A and Res_q D [def-weil-pbc-derived-morphism-presheaves, def-weil-pbc-derived-normalization-arrows]. At V, send g to the inverse component of sliceRestrictScalarsIso at A, followed by Res_q(g), followed by the forward component at D. This is a constructed natural transformation. Its naturality follows from pasting the localization and identity coefficient squares.

from.place: Functoriality of local Hom evaluation under coefficient restriction, in the normalized-presheaf evaluation argument.

proof.text: The sectionwise restriction-of-scalars square for a map of localized sites has identity components. Paste it with the two slice-restriction comparisons, and apply mapDerivedCategorySquareIso_hom_app_comp.

Expand the conjugations. Use the pasted path identities at A and D and naturality of the derived coefficient square at g. Cancel the adjacent invertible comparison components. This proves derivedRestrictionHomPresheaf_natural and supplies the naturality field of the explicitly constructed presheaf map.
